_doc: The Ashen (ADR-0048). camps: POI defs whose placed buildings are living camps (residents spawned awake when the player comes within wake_range, kept until sleep_range; the dead never come back). hostility: one world-wide score; gain per event (kill an Ashen, trespass in a camp's territory, a scout that reports back or is killed, a camp wiped out, heat raised in a territory, a raid repelled), decay_per_day. levels: 0 unaware, 1 watchers (scouts), 2 raids, 3 war parties; a level needs both its hostility and its gamestage. scouts/raids: chance per level per day (deterministic from the world seed and day). morale: 0-1; a fighter flees under `break`. fire: the outsider's fire frightens them (a held flame facing them, the player's lit fires and stations). relations: {faction: hostile|neutral}, symmetric (TD-186): the Ashen and the Hollowed fight on sight.

defs.name: The Ashen
defs.description: Tribes of the high timber, painted in lichen-ash against the Hollowed. They burn their dead and kill outsiders who might carry the Bloom.

hostility._doc: A world starts at `start` (they have watched the Program's drops for years). Each dawn: below the raid level it rises by `daily_rise` (they grow curious about the outsider; curiosity alone never brings a raid), at or above it falls by `decay_per_day` (a raid needs fresh provocation).
